name: net.storelift/storelift
description: App Store & Google Play keyword ranks, rivals, reviews, charts and AI visibility as an MCP server

environmentVariables.name: STORELIFT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Storelift API key (Pro or Studio plan). Generate at Storelift -> Settings -> API keys.

environmentVariables.name: STORELIFT_API
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://storelift.net

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer <Storelift API key> (Pro or Studio plan). Clients with MCP OAuth sign in instead.
